THE P7 TRAP, ONE CONDITIONING VARIABLE OVER - flagged before it can be repeated. 2023 has ASO ONI = +1.50, EXACTLY the strong-El-Nino boundary. Defining strong as ONI > +1.5 drops 2023 and the SAME cell reads 2 of 2 = 100pct, max residual 36.047. detail: SCOPE AND HONESTY LIMITS on the two rows above, stated rather than smoothed. (3) THE STRONG-EL-NINO CELL IS TOO THIN TO CARRY A HEADLINE ON ITS OWN - n=2 in 1991-2020 and n=3 in 1966-2024. A zero count at n=3 is not a zero rate and must not be read as one; the strong cell is reported because AEOLUS asked for it, and it is corroborated by the much larger all-El-Nino cell (n=15, also zero) and the Neutral cell (n=30, also zero), which is where the weight actually sits. (4) 2026'S OWN ASO ONI DOES NOT EXIST YET - CPC's latest published season is JJA 2026 at +1.80, and ASO requires a complete Aug-Sep-Oct. 2026 is therefore being placed in the El Nino / strong-El Nino class BY FORECAST, not by an observed ASO value, and every conditional figure above inherits that assumption.
